settings.heading: Returns + exchanges
settings.text: What you can send back, how long you have and when your refund lands.

settings.heading: 1. Return window
settings.body: Items can be sent back within 30 days of delivery. They must be unused or only lightly tested.

settings.heading: 2. Fees
settings.body: Returns by mail cost $5, deducted from the refund. Bringing an item to any boutique is free.

settings.heading: 3. Not returnable
settings.body: Final-sale markdowns, gifts with purchase, gift cards and rewards redeemed with points can't be returned.

settings.heading: 4. Refunds
settings.body: Money goes back to the original payment method about two days after the parcel is scanned in. Shipping charges are not refunded.
